title: Practical Geometry
subtitle: Veiled in sunlight, standing on the moon, wearing a crown of twelve stars—her ascension approaches.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I see. Each of us seems to have had our own adventures after we arrived. How interesting and, and ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Wonderfully fun!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: So, then we each arrived here in the stage ... I mean, in Florence, at different times. How odd.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: As far as this APPLe recalls, the instruction book didn't mention anything about that.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: So, then you and your friends came here on a sort of pilgrimage? Was it a journey of discovery, or is it simply that you wished to see the beauty of Firenze?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: *sigh* It was only supposed to be a quick journey, but something happened along the way. Accidents, murders, and now the threat of an all-out war.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Again, I'm sorry, but we're in need of your help, Mr. APPLe.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What do you mean "we"?

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: My friends and allies, my fellow Assassins.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: "Assassins" ... Mister Ezio, I need to know more about this organization of yours before making any decisions.
A straightforward request.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Okay. I'll tell you whatever you need to know; if it is in my power to tell you.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: The Assassins have a long history; we do not serve kings nor do we kill for money. We fight for peace and for the freedom of mankind.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Hmm ... That's very noble of you; I imagine you face many obstructions to that goal. Am I right that these "Templars" are one of those obstacles?

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Yes. They've long been opposed to us.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: They prefer to impose their vision of "order" on others—they will stop at nothing until they control the whole world.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: If "order" is what they're after, this APPLe does sympathize with them to some extent. There is no such thing as "absolute justice." But we can all do our best to pursue it.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: No, no ... Nothing of what they do could be called "justice."

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: This "order" they believe in is only a disguise; all they truly desire is control.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Their rise to power would be the end of freedom; no one would be spared.
The man furrows his brows, his expression revealing an unusual hint of disdain.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see.
Vertin relaxes her stance, satisfied with the hooded man's answers.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Ask anything of us, we will do it for you—anything within our reach.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Alright, as Mr. APPLe is already deeply involved in this ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I must admit I am curious about his change in appearance. Maybe we will find our answer to that in this secret chamber.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Thanks, friend.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Okay. Now that we've reached an agreement, allow me to continue studying this manuscript.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hmm, I've seen this before.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Miss Sotheby only borrowed it for us. We'll have to return it soon, so our time is short.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Let's get started and see what clues we can find!
